notes.title: New Update Deploys - Achievement Fixes & More
notes.notes:
Hey Truckers!

We're thrilled to announce that a new, important update for Alaskan Road Truckers has just been deployed across all platforms!

This update directly responds to your valuable feedback and focuses on achievement and trophy-unlocking. We conducted an additional round of rigorous testing to ensure these fixes are robust. Your patience and understanding while we perfected this have been truly appreciated!

Here’s what you can expect with this new patch:
[list]
[*] Improved Achievement/Trophy Unlocking: We’ve refined the implementation to ensure that achievements and trophies unlock smoothly and consistently.
[*] "Good Job" Achievement More Attainable: For those hunting every last achievement, we've made the "Good Job" achievement slightly more forgiving, making it more accessible for all players.
[*] Reduced PC Storage Requirements: We've optimized the game's footprint on PC, freeing up valuable storage space for you.
[*] Revealed PC Achievements: On PC, you'll now see all available achievements, making it easier to track your progress and discover new goals.
[/list]

We're confident this update will significantly enhance your achievement hunting experience in the Alaskan wilderness.


What's Next?
We're already looking ahead! Our next major focus is a performance update. We'll share more details as we get closer.

Thank you again for being such an incredible community. Keep on trucking!

notes.title: Truck Skins Pack 2 DLC & Patch 1.6
notes.notes:
To our trucking legends, both new and seasoned:

The wait is over—Patch 1.6 and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303500/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Truck_Skin_Pack_2/]Truck Skin Pack 2[/url] are live! 🚛

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
First, thank you for your passion and patience. This update is a major milestone for Alaskan Road Truckers, and we’re excited to share what’s new and improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/492064dcaf0e2157288b3a62f8041c6af82b17a9.png[/img]

[h1]Today’s launch includes[/h1]
Patch 1.6: A significant quality-of-life update that addresses community feedback and brings key improvements across all platforms:
[list]
[*] Resolved all known instances of snow and tree flickering across the entire map.
[*] Reduced save file sizes for better performance and stability.
[*] Optimized memory usage across key areas of the main map and Ice Roads.
[*] Fixed customization glitches that caused default elements to reappear after loading.
[*] Added 3 new camo skins for all platforms.
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303500/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Truck_Skin_Pack_2/]Truck Skin Pack 2[/url]: A new cosmetic DLC featuring 7 premium skins with 9 color variants, plus a free skin available for all players with 3 color variants. For those of you who spotted the hidden skins in our earlier posts—great job!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/149a90125f2981507a67d14673cc02d15cacd3cf.jpg[/img]

[h1]Looking to the future[/h1]
This is just the beginning of what’s to come for Alaskan Road Truckers. As outlined in our Roadmap 1, we’re committed to delivering a mix of premium and free content while continuing to address your feedback. Early next year, we’ll release our next major content drop, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303510/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Showrunner]Showrunner[/url]—a unique expansion that we believe will excite fans of both trucking and movies. Full details will be revealed in February, but for now, we’re keeping the specifics under wraps.

We’re thrilled to continue this journey with our incredible community. Your feedback drives our improvements, and your support motivates us to keep trucking forward.

Thank you for being part of this adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/adbd29b14c35bd9e3eacbbf3150eca9fb366bfa7.png[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.6 Notes[/h1]

[h2]PC:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved all known instances of snow and trees flickering across the entire map.
[*] Addressed the problem that could lead to a crash related to Eagle One and Conveyor interactions.
[*] Significantly reduced the size of the save file.
[*] Optimized parts of the main map and the Ice Roads for less memory usage.
[*] Added 3 new Camo skins.
[/list]

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers - Roadmap Reveal
notes.notes:
To our trucking legends both new and long time, here’s what you’ve been waiting for; a content roadmap for the future of Alaskan Road Truckers.

We heard your calls for this. It’s taken far longer than we wanted or even expected to lock the next phase of development, but we’re delighted to share it with you today. Going forward, all new content will be solely funded and released by Green Man Gaming Publishing. But enough about that, you came here to read about the future!

Today, we’re revealing Roadmap 1, featuring a mix of cosmetics, quality of life (QoL) updates and a larger content drop. While the majority of content will be premium content, we will also add free stuff for the whole community. We hope this can set the tone for future roadmaps in terms of content and cadence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/7a42129d86346f644237f937f1218041e6587bb8.jpg[/img]

We’ll update the roadmap with the full details and timings of our larger content drop, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3303510/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Showrunner/]Showrunner[/url], in February. For now, we aren’t ready to reveal more than this tease, but for those of you who love movies and driving large trucks, we think you’ll be happy. Today we can reveal that on December 19th, we will launch the next paid cosmetic pack, [url=Alaskan Road Truckers: Truck Skin Pack 2]Truck Skin Pack 2[/url], containing 7 premium skins with 9 colour variants alongside 1 free skin with 3 colour variants for all players. We will also launch our PC demo, which features a two-hour play limit.

We believe this is the start of a new and exciting phase of Alaskan Road Trucker’s life, and we are calling on our community to clap, cheer and honk your horns in support.

Patch 1.6 Notes:
[list]
[*] Resolved all known instances of snow and trees flickering across the entire map.
[*] Significantly reduced the size of the save file.
[*] Optimized parts of the main map and the Ice Roads for less memory usage.
[*] Added 3 new Camo skins.
[*] Fixed a glitch which caused default customization elements removed by the player to reappear upon loading a game.
[/list]

notes.title: Celebrating One Year on the Road – Happy Truck-iversary!
notes.notes:
Happy Truck-iversary from the beautiful Alaskan roads! It’s hard to believe that it’s been 12 months since Alaskan Road Truckers launched, and we wanted to take a moment to reflect on this amazing journey with our community.


When Green Man Gaming Publishing joined this project, we saw Road Studio’s ambitious idea to bring something fresh to the world of trucking sims—something that goes beyond the cab to deliver a deeper slice of life on the road, and we knew we wanted to be part of the journey. We’re incredibly proud of their tireless work to blend simulation, survival, and management in a way that’s both challenging and refreshing. And to our wonderful community, your continuous feedback has been invaluable in shaping the path Alaskan Road Truckers is on.


To celebrate this milestone, we’re also planning a series of upcoming discounts aimed at growing our community and keeping the roads busier than ever. We remain committed to Alaskan Road Truckers, and we look forward to sharing more details when the time is right.


Thank you for your ongoing support, and keep on trucking!

notes.title: Steam Collectibles - Out Now
notes.notes:
Happy September, trucking legends!

It isn't just about cruising The Last Frontier in style, adding the coolest skins to your in-game rig. We've now released collectibles for Alaskan Road Truckers, 25+ items to unlock and spruce up your Steam profile, including badges, trading cards and more. - One badge with 5 levels, and one foil
- 9 trading cards (Kodiak, Northern Lights, Radioactive, The American, The Classic, The Danger, The Jaws, The King of the Wastelands)
- 3 profile backgrounds
- 10 emoticons

notes.title: 1.5.1 update - optimization tweaks
notes.notes:
Hi Truckers,

We’ve made some tweaks that should speed up the loading of map parts, resulting in a smoother gameplay with less jerkiness that you might have been experiencing on the road. Let us know how it works for you in the comments or on Discord.

[h2]Patch notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimization tweaks
[*] Taking photos at Points of Interest now gives you XP
[/list]
Also, if you play using a controller, remember that you can now use a radial menu in the truck to access useful shortcuts. To use the radial menu, press and hold the interaction menu while behind the wheel.

Yours,
Michal from Road Studio

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers, Patch 1.5 + new DLC
notes.notes:
Yes, we had a quiet month. No, the reports of our demise have been greatly exaggerated. We’re still here, working away at our desks to bring you another update, addressing a range of reports from our wonderful trucking community, as well as some new cosmetic DLC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/a64eb3bbb3cd8985de03ea4cb87aa3408ab2c304.png[/img]

Truck Skin Pack is a collection of 10 skins inspired by the geometric style of real-life paint jobs of American big rigs and we have some mighty names to match their impressive designs;
[list]
[*] Winter
[*] Zeus
[*] Etos
[*] Greeno
[*] 1988
[*] Fizzy
[*] Ares
[*] Eternal
[*] SubLime
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
Ember - available for Conveyor C-87C and Eagle One

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2915720/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Truck_Skin_Pack/

Patch 1.5 covers a broad range of locations, features and fixes which we hope you all enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cd76f54f70642cf0c5a0badb8fe342bbf96e4a5f.png[/img]

[h2]Full patch notes:[/h2]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Prevented trucks from disappearing because of getting outside world bounds
[*] Fixed the issue when autosave in workshop or during truck repairs could cause problems
[*] Fixed the instances of the truck disappearing when being teleported to the hospital near Ice Roads
[*] Fixed the problem where you could die while sleeping
[*] Fixed the bug where connecting the dump trailer in Estate Construction Site could cause damage to the cargo
[*] Fixed an issue where you could lock yourself into a wall when exiting the truck
[*] Fixed the Groovy achievement
[*] Fixed the issue where the player could become immortal
[/list]

[b]Accessibility:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added colorblind correction options to graphic settings
[*] Increased the size of the font in longer location names for better visibility in the job screen
[/list]

[b]Other:[/b]
[list]
[*] Further optimization in Fairbanks, Wasilla, and Palmer, as well as optimization of specific assets, incl. trucks
[*] Reduced grass distance pop-in
[*] Improved loading times for ferry transport
[*] Fixed the floating trucks in truck store
[*] Tweaked speed limits near the refinery for better AI behavior
[*] Player now gets experience for adding coolant
[*] Fixed terrain loading near Coldfoot
[*] Reduced the fog effect in rainy weather
[*] Updated navigation near Moose Creek so GPS doesn't show a big detour
[*] Localization improvements and fixes
[*] Fixed the problem with duplicated tasks on the job list
[*] Removed some pipes from the Pump Station near Glenallen so bigger cargo can be transported without problems
[*] Fixed the tutorial book opening after closing the map using a controller
[*] Many other minor fixes
[/list]


Please make sure to drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4]Discord[/url] and share your tips and tricks for trucking success. We love to hear about your time on The Last Frontier, see the beautiful screenshots and tales of woe from people who tried (and failed) to take a turn while breaking the speed limit in pursuit of a delivery deadline. We salute/chastise you.

If you’re having technical problems, our Discord community is also a great place to report an issue and get support.

Lastly, if you are coming back to the game after an absence or have stuck with us over these months, please check to see if the review you left at launch still reflects how you feel about our wonderful mix of simulation, survival and management. We love everything we have achieved and we hope to keep bringing it to new people, with your help.

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers Development Journey: Console Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We've got some incredibly exciting news to share! After a journey filled with updates and community feedback, we're thrilled to announce that Alaskan Road Truckers: Highway Edition will be launching on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 on [b]July 11th, 2024[/b]! 🎉

As we prepare for the next big milestone, we wanted to take a moment to reflect on our journey and how our community has shaped development:
[list]
[*] PC Launch: Oct 18th, 2023
[*] Halloween Update: Oct 27th, 2023
[*] Trucking Legends Update: Nov 24th, 2023
[*] Ice Roads Expansion & Trucking Hell DLC: Dec 14th, 2023
[*] Christmas Update: Dec 22nd, 2023
[*] Patch 1.3: Mar 7th, 2024
[*] Patch 1.4: Apr 18th, 2024
[*] Console Release: Jul 11th, 2024
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/1b418f4bb2572590c5904bf4520e6551ad3dfec0.png[/img]
[h2]Alaskan Road Truckers: Highway Edition[/h2]
This new console edition includes all the DLCs and QoL updates released on PC to date and brings the thrill of the Alaskan wilderness to Xbox and PlayStation fans. Here's what you can expect:

[b]Drive[/b]
[list]
[*] Navigate the wilds of Alaska in a sprawling map with dynamic weather systems.
[*] Haul a variety of cargo through the toughest conditions.
[*] Gear up for the journey with truck maintenance and emergency repairs.
[*] 
[/list]
[b]Survive[/b]
[list]
[*] Perform roadside repairs and brave the harsh wintery conditions if stranded.
[*] Manage your hunger, fatigue, and body temperature to stay healthy.
[*] Face challenges like mudslides, avalanches, fallen trees, and blizzards.
[*] Choose from three game modes: casual, standard, and hardcore for the ultimate experience.
[/list]
[b]Thrive[/b]
[list]
[*] Customize your truck and build your reputation.
[*] Manage your HQ and master your destiny.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/fd2fd0a4328bd568a9cc7e6bcfbc2cf06b819723.jpg[/img]
Since our PC launch, you have been instrumental in shaping the game's development. We've implemented hundreds of improvements and released three DLC packs, all of which are included in Alaskan Road Truckers: Highway Edition at launch.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uKXW2wQfjj4]Check out the announce trailer here.[/url]

[b]Thank you for your continued support and feedback[/b]. We can't wait for you to experience Alaskan Road Truckers on console!

Drive. Survive. Thrive.

Keep on trucking!

The Alaskan Road Truckers Development Team

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers, Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Last month we brought you patch 1.3, our biggest single update since launch, and the response from the community was as inspiring as it was heartwarming. The development team has carried that energy through to patch 1.4 which is out now.

We fixed over 100 bugs last time and made improvements to a range of areas, and we’re not slowing down. We’re optimising the game to deliver a smooth experience, improving visuals and updating the AI to make the roads feel more realistic than ever, based on the steady stream of feedback from the community.

[h1]Full patch notes:[/h1]

[h2]Optimisation[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimisation of textures, materials and light maps
[*] Optimisation of trailers, buildings and animals
[*] Optimisation of towns: Fairbanks, Palmer, Delta Junction, North Pole, and Paxson
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d930e4c7cd891037b1bf27f2fc3323373dcfc8a2.png[/img]

[h2]Visual[/h2]
[list]
[*] Art improvements to Northern Alaskan terrain
[*] Reworked the user interface on the map screens
[*] Added the possibility to switch between light and dark UI themes
[*] Added trailer preview graphics to job descriptions
[*] Improved the look of fog and made it less dense on lower visual settings
[*] Improved the cable connecting animations
[*] Improved pop-in / draw-distance management (GPU and CPU optimization)
[*] Added company logos to container trailers
[*] Reworked the texture on dirt roads
[*] Improved the look of reflections on wet grass
[*] Made all truck skins available on all current models
[*] Lightened up all the logistic location offices during daytime
[*] Reduced the color difference between birch trees seen from afar and closer
[*] Reduced the brightness of light sources
[*] Improved the colors of traffic lights
[*] Improved the contrast and brightness on selected textures
[*] Balanced the overall contrast of the game
[*] Replaced some NPCs with better models
[*] Fixed some trucks having incorrectly applied customization components
[*] Fixed the flag flickering
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/abbdebd74d538efe7728797733ef98fd385df68e.png[/img]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased the speed of map zoom
[*] Added new controller preset and renamed presets for more clarity (Controller steering type determines the general speed and sensitivity of truck steering. Steering correction curve determines the sensitivity and dead zones of thumbsticks)
[*] Added the possibility to bind and use the radial menu on a controller
[*] Enabled scaling truck decals when using a controller
[*] Enabled switching workshop menu tabs with L1/R1/L2/R2 when using a controller
[*] Enabled using the truck shop with a controller
[*] Tweaked controller vibrations
[*] Improved the communication of binding conflicts
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the speed of AI cars around dangerous turns
[*] Improved the overtaking behavior
[*] Fixed traffic and navigation near Fairbanks
[*] Added 35 and 45 mph speed limit signs
[*] Added a new type of AI car
[*] Added one new trailer (cement tank trailer) and new jobs
[*] Made more jobs available during the early stage of the game
[*] Made it impossible to die of exposure inside the truck when the heater is on
[*] Fixed the collision problem with the big-boy military chopper trailer
[*] Reworked the traffic ticket calculation system to make the fines more realistic
[*] Improved the placement of traffic police patrol cars
[*] Oil overfill is now communicated to the player in the workshop and via a HUD icon
[*] Added auto parts stores in Prudhoe Bay and Valdez
[*] Added bulbs to stores and enabled the player to manually fix the headlights
[*] Fixed the problem where discovering new cities would not work
[*] Enabled previewing trucks in the truck store even without having the required license
[*] Adjusted the fuel capacity of trucks in higher classes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/859a9d0c56e395ec073b65bfd6e7b406935a7fa3.png[/img]

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the sound of swaying grass and twigs breaking when driving on grass surfaces
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a rare instance of trucks disappearing from the parking spot
[/list]

If you want to chat with us in more detail about ideas or issues, our [url=https://discord.com/invite/TVWqt38]discord[/url] is a great way to keep in touch and we love to hear from our players, and you can help shape the future of Alaskan Road Truckers with your input.

If you’re returning after a long absence, take a look around, kick the tyres, see what’s new in the world. We’ve worked hard to address the feedback at every stage and we’re immensely proud of how the game has grown, so if you previously gave us a negative review, see how things stack up now. Maybe you’ll be inspired to write a new review and let us know how we’re doing.

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers - Welcome Back, Truckers
notes.notes:
We asked for feedback and you delivered. You asked us to listen, and today we’re delivering. Since launch, the dev team has worked hard to collate and address the community’s requests and tomorrow, Wed 6th, we’ll set live Update 1.3, our biggest QoL patch to date. The patch notes are below and this marks the first of two planned updates, with the second targeting early April, which will tackle vehicle physics, optimisation and graphics, and many other areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/4c4324cdf09b5b50b5ed72136e71dabd6eb07c07.jpg[/img]

With 2023 in the rearview mirror, we’ve reflected on the highs and lows and we’re truly excited about what we can all achieve together. 

Also, because you all keep asking, console is still happening. Things are progressing nicely and we’re all excited to discuss it in detail a little later. For now, just know that we’re still targeting an H1 24 release.

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] New “Console” controller preset with analog steering
[*] Prevented disconnecting the wheel when using a different input type
[*] Added option to increase or decrease steering speed on keyboard and controller
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/8c9a2f400061d4e23236f274c433cd01b3a4fc0e.jpg[/img]

[h2]AI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Faster cars
[*] Smoother turning
[*] No sudden stops
[*] Overtaking slow players
[*] Cars honk in traffic jams
[*] Traffic ticket system improvements
[/list]

[h2]Performance[/h2]
[list]
[*] Part 1 of planned work
[*] Focus on improving the stability of the framerate
[*] Optimized memory usage
[*] Improved autosave system to reduce hitches, the game now saves smoothly
[*] Added option to disable animals rendering to increase frame rate
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/42afa1649f1a7f95145944d570f76fb1d00612e5.png[/img]

[h2]Visuals[/h2]
[list]
[*] Generally less visual pop-in (part of ongoing improvements, more to follow)
[*] Better level-of-detail transitions
[*] Improved the look of snow tracks
[*] Improved the look of rain
[*] The third-person camera is not blocked by objects anymore
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved the position of multiple logistic location parking spaces
[*] Improved the parking scoring system
[*] Improved GPS pathing
[*] Reduced the backward pull when moving forward from full stop
[*] Fixes to 100+ reported issues
[/list]

[h2]Important Information[/h2]
[b]Help us test DX 11 & DX 12:[/b] If you're able to switch between DX11 and DX12, we encourage you to try DX12 and share your feedback with us on [url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4]Discord[/url]. Your input will be invaluable in making further improvements to enhance your gaming experience.

[b]Regarding Installation:[/b] Due to the substantial size of the patch, installation may have been heavy. If you encounter any issues after updating, try the following steps:
[list]
[*] Restart your system.
[*] Verify files with Steam.
[*] Consider reinstalling the entire game if problems persist. This should resolve most issues.
[/list]
 
[b]Need Further Assistance?[/b] If you continue to experience issues, please don't hesitate to reach out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4]Discord[/url]. Our team is here to assist you and ensure you have the best possible gameplay experience.

[b]A Request from Us:[/b] If you previously left a negative review and find that the new patch has improved your experience, we kindly ask you to reconsider your review and support us with a positive rating. Your feedback means the world to us!

notes.title: Developer Dispatch: What to Expect in Our Next Alaskan Road Truckers Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I know we haven't talked for a long time, but we had reasons. Do you know those stories about people who "lock themselves in the garage" and work on something until they finish it? That's us. For the past two months, we've been updating Alaskan Road Truckers to address the community feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]

[h2][b]AI[/b][/h2]
[b]First up was AI[/b], which has become faster, smoother, and more natural. Cars will overtake you if you drive too slowly and honk their horn if you create a traffic jam, bringing our world to life. We've improved the foliage, which now transitions much more smoothly between different levels of detail as it approaches the screen. We've increased the draw distance of distant lands - although here we haven't yet reached the target effect, the work continues and you'll see more improvements in the next patch. It’s a matter of balancing between the visuals and memory usage.

[h2][b]Fixes[/b][/h2]
[b]We fixed more than a hundred bugs reported by you[/b]. We removed - hopefully finally - problems like the truck shooting into space or getting stuck on the base computer screen. If there are more, keep reporting them. We’re reading your posts, we’re here, and we’ve just been heads down while working to make this the very best experience for you all.

[h2][b]Optimization[/b][/h2]
[b]Optimization [/b]took place in several stages and was carried out by several "teams." First, a lot of time was spent on profiling, i.e. identifying what didn't work best and what could be improved. To do this, we consulted with the best from our gamedev backyard. We still need to finish the work in this area as well, but you will probably already notice that the game runs much smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/bb16cad4c201448051381997ea173ea0f66b8bc1.png[/img]

[h2][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h2]
On top of that, we've made quite a few [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b]. You can now change the steering wheel turning speed on the controller or keyboard. We've changed the options screen so that more attention is drawn to the options most requested. We introduced a new preset for the controller, going toward more "console" solutions. All of the above, by the way, was another part of our ongoing work on the [b]console version[/b], which we will be able to talk about soon, but everything is on track and looking promising. 

At the same time, we continue to work on improving the PC version. We hope this will be reflected in your feedback. Our goal is to make ART a game worth sinking into. Are we moving in the right direction? You tell us!

We wish you a great Alaskan experience.
[b]Michal from Road Studio[/b]

notes.title: Addressing Community Feedback and Looking Ahead
notes.notes:
Hello Truckers,

We hope you're all enjoying your journeys through the wilds of Alaska! We wanted to take a moment to express our gratitude for your continued support and engagement with Alaskan Road Truckers. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the direction of our game, and we're committed to delivering an even better experience based on your insights.

[h2][b]Tackling Top Priorities[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/63577a68b55aeba136d66ce026bec7ca742d30d6.png[/img]
We've heard you loud and clear regarding some of the key issues affecting gameplay, and we want to assure you that the team is already hard at work addressing them. Specifically, we're focusing our efforts on the following areas:
[list]
[*] AI Behaviors: Improving AI behaviors to enhance immersion and realism in the game.
[*] Performance Optimization: Addressing performance dips and frame rate issues to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] Controller Fixes: Resolving setup problems and bugs related to controllers.
[*] UI Enhancements: Making necessary UI fixes to improve usability and navigation within the game.
[*] And more!
[/list]
If you haven’t had the chance to fill in the questionnaire, you can find it here: [b][url=https://forms.gle/aBJKdS2yCfb23YUE7]Alaskan Road Truckers 2024 Questionnaire[/url][/b]

Please ensure that when completing our questionnaire, you provide as much detail and specificity as possible. Your input is invaluable in helping us identify, isolate, and address the issues that are most important to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/1bf7c1b8705b9916ec4726d844c72cab034f884a.png[/img]

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers in 2024 - Trucking into the New Year
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

2024 has arrived on our doorsteps and we’re raring to go with a whole year of Alaskan trucking.

We’ve got big plans for 2024 and while we can’t get into specifics just yet - we wanted to let you know what we’re working on.

[h2][b]Goodbye 2023, Hello 2024![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/f533e523d2082d91c291fa09f565ef102c1e637e.png[/img]
Firstly, 2023 was a hell of a year for us. We went to Gamescom, had playtests, released Alaskan Road Truckers and even managed to release an expansion, DLC, seasonal events, and many patches to update and improve the Alaskan Road Truckers experience.

We’re so grateful to everyone who played Alaskan Road Truckers in 2023. We couldn’t have got here without your reviews, comments, feedback, streams, and videos. Everything you’ve shared with us has helped us refine our game, make it better, and has helped shape the future of Alaskan Road Truckers.

[h2][b]2024 Priorities[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]
The New Year is a time for reflection and resolutions. That’s why we’ve decided to take a hard look at Alaskan Road Truckers and work on the areas we feel matter most that will improve the experience of playing our game.

For the moment we are pausing any work on additional content for the game while we devote all our resources to bug fixing, controller and steering wheel issues, and making sure we resolve the issues that get in-between you and the full Alaskan Road Truckers experience.

We still have plans to add to our game, from adding more customization options to more content, but we feel right now the focus has to be on the core game. The next game updates from us will be all about improving the game, not about adding extra stuff. We feel that this is the right call to make now, and we hope you agree as you see Alaskan Road Truckers get into fighting shape.
[h3]Alaskan Road Truckers on Console[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/bb16cad4c201448051381997ea173ea0f66b8bc1.png[/img]
We remain committed to releasing Alaskan Road Truckers on P55 and Xbox Series X/S consoles. We cannot share release date details just yet but we are working towards a full Alaskan Road Truckers release on console.

The priority right now is making the base game sparkle. As soon as Alaskan Road Truckers is trucking along nicely, we’ll have more definitive news for eager console truckers.

We know that this isn’t the news a lot of console players have been waiting for, but we hope to have more concrete information to share with you over the coming weeks. 

[h2][b]Have Your Say[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d8d76b6e1b86960b6ce6d30edd5bab0606aadae1.png[/img]
We read every single one of your comments, social media posts, and what our community has to say on Discord. However, we want to make sure we’re hearing what you have to say clearly about the current state of Alaskan Road Truckers and also what we should be working on in the future.

We’ve set up a detailed questionnaire for you to fill out - it covers a variety of different areas related to the game and asks for you to relate your current experience with Alaskan Road Truckers. If you could take the time to fill it out, we’d be endlessly grateful.

[b][url=https://forms.gle/aBJKdS2yCfb23YUE7]Alaskan Road Truckers 2024 Questionnaire[/url][/b]

Please note if you do fill out our questionnaire then do try to be as detailed and specific as possible. Everything helps us locate, isolate, and resolve the issues that matter most to you.

[h3]Xmas Tree at the Base[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/52256a505c4adfa43da750ff29e13c0fb305b82a.png[/img]
Decorate your trucking base with a festive touch. The new Xmas tree brings the holiday spirit to your headquarters, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

[h3]Xmas Sweaters for Characters[/h3]
Dress your characters in cozy Xmas sweaters. Whether you're braving the elements or taking a break at a truck stop, you'll look and feel festive all the way.

[h3]Hidden Snowmen[/h3]
Discover hidden snowmen scattered throughout the game. Screenshot them and share on our Discord for a special reward. Can you find them all?

[h3]The Great Snowman Hunt[/h3]
That's not all - out there, somewhere, a twisted snowman that's unlike any other lurks ready to be found. If you are first to find it, take a screenshot, and report back to our Discord, you can win a special prize. We'll say no more - good luck out there.

[h2][b]The Influencers are Here![/b][/h2]
Since launch (and even before launch) we've had some amazing support from brilliant influencers out there on Twitch, YouTube, and TikTok. So we decided to start paying that back!

Now you can show your support for your favorite influencers by decking out your truck with their logos as decals. Drive in style and let the world know who inspires your trucking journey.

[h2][b]Merry Fixmas![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cb631457c1b7fd7f26dad8553e923ed818fbfce9.png[/img]
Of course, new stuff is nice but we wanted to give you one last Christmas present. 

Today's update doesn't just add a Christmas theme to the game, we've been hard at work focusing on performance issues. So if you were experiencing performance or FPS issues in the past, please try Alaskan Road Truckers again after downloading today's update and see if the game experience is better for you.

Our work on Alaskan Road Truckers is continual and we are making progress on the issues you report to us. We hope that this update will make the game much more playable for those of you who experienced issues related to performance, and we can't wait to see you back on the road enjoying the game.

If you do continue to experience performance (or other) issues, please don't hesitate to let us know. Every report helps us focus our efforts on the issues that matter to you - so please keep them coming, everything helps.

That's it for us this time. See you on the road, Christmas truckers!

notes.title: Free Ice Roads Expansion Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

We’ve got a gigantic truckload of updates for you today. Alaskan Road Truckers has its first full expansion filled with challenges, new locations, and much more. What’s better is that it’s free and comes along with a big update for the main game too. 

Here’s the lowdown on the Ice Roads Expansion for Alaskan Road Truckers:

[h2][b]Stay Frosty on the Ice Roads[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/0577fde4a88068f1ebdcf546ea6a1f9a855275f1.png[/img]
One of the core things we wanted to focus on in Alaskan Road Truckers is that feeling of teetering on the edge between success and disaster. That’s why our game has features like hunger, temperature, and more to make the world immersive and put you in the boots of an Alaskan trucker.

Our new expansion, Ice Roads, cranks everything up a notch. In it you’ll find a whole new area to explore that adds a ton of new roads and routes to the game, all focused around the coldest of conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/63769fcb7e3b6bc5f62644a2739d7f47fe51e2ae.png[/img]
If you’ve been looking for a new challenge, if you’ve been looking to drive tougher, narrower, more dangerous roads, or if you just love snow and ice - the Ice Roads Expansion should give you everything you’re looking for. 

In addition to new routes and areas, there’s new missions, new cargo types, new mechanics, new consumables…there’s a lot of new! Check out the brand new Ice Roads Expansion trailer for a peek at what awaits you:

[previewyoutube=BkEutdic26o;full]<TRAILER LINK>
[/previewyoutube]
Here’s everything you’ll find in the expansion:
[list][*] New Region - Ice Roads
[*] New Mountain and Cliffside Roads
[*] New Playable Character - Lisa Kelly!
[*] 7 new Cargo Types
[*] 7 new Logistic Locations
[*] 8 new Points of Interest 
[*] 1 secret Point of Interest
[*] New Mechanic: Breakable Ice
[*] New Mechanic: Ferry Transport (available in Summer)
[*] New Consumables
[*] Snow All-Year Long  in the Ice Roads DLC Area
[*] Lower Temperatures
[*] Extreme Cold 
[*] New Medical Facility
[*] Tons of Secrets and Easter Eggs[/list]
If you can’t wait to get behind the wheel and test your skills out there on the ice, you don’t have to wait any longer. The Ice Roads Expansion is out now and it’s free for everyone who owns Alaskan Road Truckers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704590/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Ice_Roads/

We’re proud to introduce you to the Trucking Hell cosmetic DLC, giving you a swathe of brutal and badass customization options for your player and your truck.

Hello truckers!

It's been a few weeks since we launched Alaskan Road Truckers, and we decided to take a moment and look back at the road behind us and give you all a sneak peek at the road in front.

We've come a long way already, and we're not stopping here. In case you've missed some of our updates or want to know what we're working on right now - here we go!

[h2][b]The Road So Far...[/b][/h2]

[h3]Trucking Legends[/h3]

[previewyoutube=RkLbHw3GWs8;full][/previewyoutube]
Our most recent update was titled [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/849100/announcements/detail/3906371681114520760]Trucking Legends[/url][/b]. It launched last week and changed up some of the ways players can experience the game.

In addition to the standard mode, players are now able to select Casual and Legend options when starting a new game. These tweak the difficulty of the core Alaskan Road Trucker experience. Casual mode makes the game a little easier, with resources being consumed less quickly and weather being easier to manage. Legend mode, however, tests your trucking skills to the limit. 

With harder missions, a tougher Winter start, and punishing weather, if you want to prove yourself out there in the harsh Alaskan Wilderness, this is the mode for you.

[h3]Patches, Patches, Patches![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/03cb1da1ac9ecba68892553d89c28c5a63c9c66c.png[/img]

Of course, we've not just added new content to the game. There's been a ton of patches released since launch all aimed at fixing and improving the issues that matter to you - our players. Your feedback and reports have helped us aim our efforts in the right direction, and we've come a long way.

That doesn't mean we're satisfied and sitting on our laurels. We are continually refining Alaskan Road Truckers, working on areas such as AI, controller issues, game-feel, optimization, and game balance. In the coming weeks and months you'll see many updates from us - all aimed at improving the core game experience.

[h2][b]Where We're Heading[/b][/h2]

[h3]Fancy Trucks and Looks[/h3]
One thing we know is important is making your truck feel like it's yours. We've already released some new cosmetic options for trucks and of course, there's the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600800/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Mother_Truckers_Edition/]Mother Truckers Edition DLC[/url] but we're also looking at making more.

Being a badass is part of the trucker experience and our next set of cosmetics will reflect that, with a rough 'n' ready look that'll show off your rugged style in spades.

[h3]Ice Roads are Coming[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/0973cd1a4bcfff1ce343c5edc1958a1a3a982076.png[/img]

The big update that we're focusing on right now will add more depth to the game, as well as more challenge. We spoke about it before in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/849100/view/5779865497754063927?l=english]Roadmap [/url]but we're getting closer and closer to unveiling the Ice Roads Expansion for Alaskan Road Truckers.

This expansion will put you and your truck on the edge of danger as you fight for survival against the harshest of elements. Only the toughest, bravest, and most skilled truckers will be able to succeed in these brand-new missions. With all new looks, routes, and terrain to conquer - this will take Alaskan Road Truckers to the next level.

[h3]And more...[/h3]
Our plans don't end there, we're working on more content, more ideas, and more everything. From launching on console to further expansions and DLC, we've got big plans, and we can't wait to take you along for the ride!

notes.title: Trucking Legends Update - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

We've just launched a brand new update for Alaskan Road Truckers. One of the key pieces of feedback has been about customizing your trucker journey, being able to choose a little more and play the game your way.

This update aims to address that. That's why we're inviting you to...

[h2][b]Become a Trucking Legend![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=RkLbHw3GWs8;full][/previewyoutube]
The Trucking Legends Update will give you three options to choose from when you start a new game. In addition to the standard balanced normal mode, you'll also have [b]Casual [/b]and [b]Legend [/b]options to choose from.

In Casual mode you'll experience an easier time when delivering, perfect if you just want to sit back and get on with trucking. Resources will deplete less fast, the weather will be less punishing - overall it'll be a kinder expeirence.

If you want to test your skills, however, you can choose the new Legend mode. Here you'll start in the depths of winter. Weather will be harder to deal with, missions will be tougher. The game will be much harder to play, and you'll have to fight for survival to become a true Trucking Legend.

[h2][b]Trucking Legend Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/27ebeec3cba9ac9441f99bf1a107b8bda73189bc.png[/img]
[list][*] New game modes! (We may add more in the future)[/list]
[b]Casual[/b]
Better weather, more time for delivery and slower consumption of resources. You start in the summer.

[b]Standard[/b]
This is the intended, balanced experience.

[b]Legend[/b]
Difficult weather conditions and more demanding orders. You start in winter, with a jacket and wheel chains in your truck's equipment.

[list][*] New Legend truck skin, available in customization workshops.
[*] DLSS will now save properly after you set it and won't reset every time you launch the game. However, upon the introduction of the update, you will need to set your DLSS one final time.
[*] Mechanics related to time flow are now fixed, parts or resources do not deplete when leaving the game on idle, sleeping, or being transported to the Hospital.
[*] New controller scheme that can be selected in the Settings, offering a similar experience to other games in the genre.
[*] Fixes to the way many texts are displayed, they should not go over the border anymore.
[*] Fixed the bug that could cause a disappeareance of the truck left in the HQ.
[*] Optimization of the southern part of the map. The optimization process as a whole continues.
[*] Revamping the interior of the starting truck Westend Sorrow 420. More detail, better textures.
[*] Fixed the bug that could cause the player to freeze when sleeping at a motel or being at the HQ.
[*] Improved the way snow tracks are displayed.
[*] Fixed the XP rewards for POI photos, incl. retroactively awarding the points for pics already taken.
[*] Also: Additional optimization tweaks and general fixes, incl. translation fixes, based on community feedback from update testing.[/list]

notes.title: Supporting Alaskan Road Truckers - The Patch Plan
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

We’ve had a busy time since the launch of Alaskan Road Truckers. With nine patches for our game since launch (and more incoming!) we thought it’d be a great time to talk to you all about what our plans are for Alaskan Road Truckers and how we’ll be supporting the game into the future.

[h2][b]Alaskan Road Truckers - The Goal[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cb631457c1b7fd7f26dad8553e923ed818fbfce9.png[/img]
We want to make the best trucker game ever made, where you live, breathe, and survive as a trucker in one of the most punishing environments on the planet. That’s been our goal since day one and it still is today. 

It’s fair to say that we haven’t hit that goal yet. Alaskan Road Truckers is a game we’re incredibly proud of, but we know it still needs work. Technical issues, bugs, and quality of life issues have overshadowed the wonderful experience we’ve put in the core of Alaskan Road Truckers, and we recognize that this has caused disappointment for some.

We want you to know that we hear you. We know that for some players the issues affecting Alaskan Road Truckers has meant they have been unable to enjoy the game, and this is why we have been introducing rapid fixes to help those players get in the game and start trucking. Every patch has improved the game, with the core experience now being more accessible, key bugs are fixed, and for most the game should be more playable.

Of course, we have lots of work still to do, and there are key areas we will be focusing on as we continue to support Alaskan Road Truckers through the rest of 2023 - and beyond.

[h2][b]Post-Release Patch Plan[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]
As mentioned above, we have been working on rapid patches for the most pressing issues. Now, we’re moving into a separate phase of our support plan, where we’ll be reducing the amount of patches we release and focusing on larger updates which will resolve more issues, to provide a more stable Alaskan Road Truckers experience. The issues we’re working on are bigger issues, ones that will take more time to resolve, and for a small team this means we’ll have to slow down a little bit to make sure we get these patches done right.

The areas we’re focusing on at the moment are:
[list][*]AI Tweaks and Improvements
[*]Optimization and Performance Enhancements
[*]Controller / Steering Wheel Improvements[/list]These are large things for us to tackle but we are making a commitment to get these issues ironed out and make sure that Alaskan Road Truckers is brought up to a technical level we are happy with. We cannot say that these will be fixed in one patch, or even two, but incremental improvements will be made and we are putting our focus on resolving these key areas sooner rather than later.

This, of course, doesn’t mean we are neglecting other bug reports and issues reported to us. As we continue to update and patch our game, we’ll be fixing other issues alongside working on the bigger things, you’ll be able to see what we’re fixing in each set of patch notes.

In addition to the above, we are working to get the console version of the game for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S complete and ready for release as soon as possible. We will have news to share about this very soon.

We will also be adhering to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/849100/view/5779865497754063927]content roadmap[/url]. So while we will be working on these issues, we will also be producing content and updates that will expand and deepen the core Alaskan Road Truckers experience. Look out for more news on these updates soon!

[h2][b]Update Testing[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/da4a6138313b37a9cd3e1bab3b0b24e4d87877eb.png[/img]
One of the points we’ve made continuously throughout development of Alaskan Road Truckers is that we haven’t made this game alone. Now the game is out in the world; this is still true.

Your bug reports, issue reports, reviews, and technical reports have helped us to laser focus our work on the things that really matter to the people who matter - you. That’s why we’re asking for your help again, this time in helping us test upcoming updates.

If you’re interested in helping us test updates, please [url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4]head over to our Discord server[/url] where you can find details of how to opt in to the beta branch of the game as well as where you can post any issues you encounter. We made the decision to run this initiative using our Discord server as a central hub as it allows us to monitor + track issues, and respond to feedback in real-time, helping us to better work on any issues that may crop up. 

Thank you to everyone who takes part in this - we do test our own patches, but we are a small team so more hands on the testing wheel means more stable patches. 

We’ve got a long road ahead of us and we hope you’ll continue to join us on it. See you out there, truckers!

It's patch time! Get your hands on the latest update for Alaskan Road Truckers - we're continuing to fix bugs, solve issues, and make the game better. 

Here's what's new in today's patch:

[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/fb92c5f5c9879b11f29e74b2213d69bfc2550541.png[/img]
[list][*] Corrected navigation to all logistic locations south of the starting location.
[*] Tweaked the deer near the starting location.
[*] Added Halloween mini icons to Customization Parts and Stickers.
[*] Small optimization tweaks.
[*] Prevented a scenario where cancelling an order could result in a crash.
[*] Cancelling an order now will not remove backup saves.[/list]We're also working on dramatically improving stability and reduce the occurance of bugs cropping up in future updates. In order to help us with this process, we're asking the community to...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cb631457c1b7fd7f26dad8553e923ed818fbfce9.png[/img]

That's why we've activated the Update Testing branch on Steam. If you're interested in taking part, testing out big updates, and helping make a difference, [url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4]head over to our Discord where you can find all the details you need[/url].

Thank you to everyone who takes part!

notes.title: BOO! It's the Halloween Truck or Treat Event + Patch #8
notes.notes:
Hello-ween truckers!

It's that time of year, the time when spirits rise, ghouls emerge from the gloom, and monsters of all sorts lurk just out of sight, hiding in the corner of your eye. 

In Alaskan Road Truckers the spookiest of seasons has begun with a bang, scream, and a terrified whimper. Welcome, truckers, to the [b]Truck or Treat[/b] Halloween Event!

[h2][b]Truck or Treat Halloween Event[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/99812abdf2c9509a8dcdd757ee9508d28045d669.png[/img]

Halloween has hit the haulage business with a spooky smash. Throughout Alaska you'll find that things have taken on a touch of the macabre, giving Alaskan Road Truckers a terrifying twist!

Here's what you can expect to find out on the roads, alone, with no-one to find you...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/f29cb0cd8ede7b4f37558f88012bf1484bbcf007.png[/img][list][*] New horrifying Halloween skin for every truck
[*] 20 terrifying Halloween decals
[*] Spooktakular customization parts such as vampire bat wings
[*] Special new cargo: THE WORLD'S BIGGEST PUMPKINS
[*] And maybe something lurks deep within your HQ. Maybe you should go there...or not...[/list]It's enough to send shivers down your spine. This event runs from today, the 27th of October, for two weeks - so hit the road and experience the scariest season of all from the comfort of your truck!

But that's not all - if you're bold enough to take to the roads this Halloween then you'll also be able take part in the Great Pumpkin King Hunt.

[h2][b]The Great Pumpkin King Hunt![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/9dce9810840bde65a52736abd1cf8417482c0553.png[/img]
Somewhere in the world the Pumpkin King awaits truckers who are brave enough to search it out.

Who is it? What does it want? What does it look like? Well we're not going to make it that easy for you!

If you find the Pumpkin King, take a screenshot and post it on the [url=https://discord.gg/7nzKkAVgN4]#alaskan-screenshots channel in our Discord[/url]. The first to find the Pumpkin King and report back with a screenshot posted in that channel will win a SPOOKY REWARD!*

[i]*reward may not be that spooky[/i]

[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/30ca65119150816d6da008ce58ddb753ad9e506f.png[/img]

Today's update isn't just a truckload of spooky fun, we've also got a patch for you! Here's what's changed:
[list][*] Fix for cargo spawns in Susitna
[*] Fix for trailer spawn in Prudhoe Bay workshop
[*] Added Trebory Milk Farm trailer
[*] Changed Parameters of the trucks to make their top speeds more realistic
[*] Fixed dashboards speedometers in Eagle One
[*] Windshield now freezes more easily during Winter
[*] Corrected navigation to Logistic Locations in Palmer, Sutton-Alpine, Chickaloon, Glennallen
[*] Small shader-related optimization fixes
[*] AI now should overtake the truck with trailer attached
[*] Added icon to represent broken headlights
[*] Brigthened up the night a bit
[*] Turn indicator should now not pop up when route is not set
[*] No snowfall under gas station sheds[/list][b]Known issue #1[/b]: We are aware of a rare instance when loading a game, when you play as the sunglasses guy (not the DLC one), you may not see any truck interactions. In this case reloading the game should solve the problem, but we are working on a fix for this with a future update.

[b]Known issue #2[/b]: In this patch if you cancel a job, your backup save will be removed. When you complete another job, your backup save will be reinstated. We will be introducing an update to fix this and make sure that backup saves can never be removed.

Here are links to previous patch notes so you can check out what's changed so far!

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers Patch #7
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

We've got a patch all ready for you and you can download it right now. After today's patch, the game should feel better to play and should be more immersive. You'll also see a ton of bugs fixed too.

Here's what's new:
[h2][b]Patch Notes[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/efc5a5e73a55b8f649d16d288ba9a49017b212a4.png[/img]
[list][*] Fixed the seasons skipping improperly
[*] Improved the look of nights
[*] AI - new overtaking and a lot of other improvements
[*] Visted POI icons will now work properly after loading the game
[*] Parking markers are now visible in rearview mirrors
[*] When picking up a transport mission, the destination logistic location will now highlight on map
[*] Fix for Coolant Temperature tutorial not working as intended
[*] Fix for a bug in which, if the player canceled a mission, the Logistic Location that was the target of that mission would break and player would no longer be able to take new missions from that location
[*] Changed parking area which will represent parking space in a more accurate way, so parking should be easier while minimalizing the risk of bugs
[*] Newly bought trucks will now spawn with a proper offset, which will place them in a more accurate position in the parking spot
[*] Fix for a bug where the player cannot accept new transport missions after cancelling one
[*] Player should now be unable to interact with hood when holding a fuel pump pistol
[*] Prudhoe Bay truck garage entrance tweaks
[*] New parameterization for sky curves and night gamma tweak
[*] Fix for starting tutorials not always launching properly
[*] Added Valdez Workshop Icon on the map
[*] Logbook tutorial is now a one-time message
[*] Improved naviagation to multiple logistic locations
[*] Fixed free inventory slots not initializing properly
[*] Fixed multiple issues in cooking devices related to saving
[*] Fixed numerous bugs on the map
[*] Fixed indestructible signs found by the community
[*] Discord totem update
[*] Small optimization tweaks
[*] Small localization fixes
[*] New starry skybox
[*] Added mapping range for coolant for the dashboard
[*] Moved All of the Truck Skins above the Paint Jobs in Customization Workshop Menu
[*] Fix for Incorrect placement of Bellforge 303 Skins
[*] When loading a game, player character's head will no longer be visible in front of the camera
[*] Wipers will now unfreeze after using a scraper
[*] Trailer supports will now properly retract when using Roadside Assistance
[*] Fix for trailer positioning after using Roadside Assistance in Prudhoe Bay workshop[/list]
That's it for patch news today, we'll have more for you as we continue to work on our game. Please do keep the bug and issue reports coming, and your suggestions too - all feedback welcome!

Please also remember to leave a review on Steam - your honest review. Everything helps us make Alaskan Road Truckers better.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

It’s finally here. The day, the moment, everything’s been building up to this point.
[h2][b]Alaskan Road Truckers is out now![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/5e035f8dd86ef8d7e1be7bdf862bb31dfbe1498a.png[/img]
Just like trucking in Alaska, our journey has been long and has had a few bumps in the road - but we’ve made it to the PC launch of the game. You can now buy and download the game - and for the first week you can grab [b]10% off[/b]!

We’ll also be doing a [b]live stream[/b] to celebrate the launch, you can tune in over on our Steam Page. Come join the chat and hang out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/849100/Alaskan_Road_Truckers/

We’ve also released a cosmetic pack for the game. If you want to help support the game, and want to look more badass when hitting the wild roads of Alaska, pick up the Mother Truckers Edition DLC for some exclusive truck cosmetics and a brand new character:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2600800/Alaskan_Road_Truckers_Mother_Truckers/

Now the game’s out, it’s time to start your journey towards becoming a trucking legend. Survive, drive, and thrive in one of the harshest environments in the world. We can’t wait for you to hit the roads with us - see you in Alaska!

[h2][b]What’s next?[/b][/h2]
Launching Alaskan Road Truckers doesn’t mean we’re ending our work on the game. We know there’ll be bugs, issues, and stuff to fix - we’ll be continually patching the game over the coming days, weeks, and months to ensure the game experience is everything we intend it to be.

Patching the game is only the start of our support, if you haven’t already - check out our roadmap announcement where you can get a sneak peek at some of the stuff we’ll be adding to the PC version over the next few months:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/849100/view/5779865497754063927

We’re also going to be working on getting the console version out for release. Console fans - stay tuned, we’ll have news for you very soon.

[h2][b]How you can help[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cb631457c1b7fd7f26dad8553e923ed818fbfce9.png[/img]
We aren’t making this game alone - your input, feedback, and support has helped us get here. Our community is frankly, amazing, and through playtests and the long wait in getting the game ready for release we’ve been stunned at the support we’ve received.

Now the game is out, there’s a few things you can do to help us make sure that Alaskan Road Truckers is a success.
[h3]Leave a Steam Review[/h3]
After playing the game for a few hours, why not leave us a Steam review? Every review helps us gain visibility which in turn helps the game get in front of more people.

If you love the game, let us know. If you don’t love the game, please also let us know - negative feedback is just as important as positive, and maybe we’ll be able to fix or work on any issues affecting your enjoyment of the game.

But please - do leave a Steam review, we’d love to hear what you think.
[h3]Report Bugs and Issues[/h3]
If you encounter any issues in the game, first please check our support FAQ document - this is a work in progress support article that we’ll be adding to, making sure you have the info you need in order to enjoy Alaska.

If your issue isn’t there, or it isn’t fixed by the steps listed there, please let us know. You can do so either here on Steam or in our Discord. Please let us know as much information as possible, everything helps us to help you.
[h3]Spread the Word[/h3]
Tell a friend! Tell two friends! Hire a plane to do skywriting!

OK, maybe not that last one.

But word of mouth is the most important way to support Alaskan Road Truckers. If you have a friend who’d enjoy the game, let them know about it. If you have social media, why not do a post. We’re incredibly grateful to all the fans who’ve supported us so far - and we’re grateful for everyone who continues to support us. 
[h3]Buy or Wishlist the Game![/h3]
Finally, buying the game helps us make sure we can continue to support it, adding content and fixing issues into the future. If you cannot do that now - or don’t want to - please add us to your Steam wishlist, it all helps.

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers Post-Launch Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

Tomorrow will see Alaskan Road Truckers launch onto PC. After years of waiting and hard work, we’re ready to send our Alaskan baby out into the world for the very first time. We can’t wait to hear what you think about our game - but before we launch, we’ve got some news for you.

We want you to all know that when you pick up Alaskan Road Truckers, you’re taking a journey with us. That journey doesn’t end on the 18th of October; it’s just beginning, for us, for the game, and for you!

We plan to keep updating Alaskan Road Truckers after it launches, both in terms of patches and bug fixes, but also with new content and stuff to see and do.

Here’s what we’ve currently got planned - it’s time to check out…

[h2][b]The Alaskan Road Truckers Post-Launch Roadmap[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/048e9f55317915b4243d4cd12c6c34f9b849a609.png[/img]
That’s right, we’ve got big plans for Alaskan Road Truckers after it launches, and we want to give you a sneak-peek of what new stuff we’re going to be working on.

So here’s a look at the first few months of Alaskan Road Truckers and what we will be bringing to the PC version!

[i]Please note this roadmap only details updates for the PC version of Alaskan Road Truckers. Console fans - we'll have an announcement for you soon.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/3e6354076017737c955de6673ad6f2fc14280882.png[/img]

[list][*]Steam PC launch
[*]Mother Truckers Edition DLC
[*]New badass truck[/list]October is all about launching Alaskan Road Truckers but you’ll also be able to get your hands on the Mother Truckers Edition DLC, giving you exclusive skins and ornaments for your truck as well as a badass new character to play as. The Mother Truckers Edition  DLC will only be available for a limited time only, so grab it fast!

We’ll be adding a brand new truck later in the month to celebrate the launch - something a little…different. More info coming soon!
[h3]November 2023[/h3]
[list][*]Trucking Legend Mode
[*]Skin & Decal Pack[/list]We know you can’t wait to get stuck into the snow so we’ll be adding a brand new game mode where you’ll start in Winter, with few resources, ready to survive in the harsh Alaskan cold. For truckers looking for more of a challenge - this is the one for you.

We’ll also have new skins and decals for your truck, so you can show off more of your style on the wild Alaskan roads.
[h3]December 2023[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/25ce8310b8f04f411b9a4d873e77ca40408e50f0.png[/img][list][*]Ice Road Expansion
[*]Christmas Update[/list]The first major update for Alaskan Road Truckers will be hitting in December, with the release of our Ice Road Expansion. This will add entirely new routes, roads, and missions for you to conquer - all featuring treacherous icy roads that’ll test your trucking skills to the limit.

We’ll also be adding some holiday cheer to celebrate Christmas, watch out for a round guy in red!
[h3]January 2024[/h3]
[list][*]Expanded Country Roads Network
[*]Internal Cab Customization[/list]In the New Year you can expect to get your hands on our brand new update where we’ll increase the amount of small dirt track roads you can drive on. Existing towns will be interconnected with smaller country roads, so you’ll be able to head off the beaten path and forge your own route through the wilderness.

As well as that, we’ll be releasing the Internal Cab Customization update. You’ll already have access to skins, wraps, and decals for the exterior of your truck, but what about the interior? Make your cab your home away from home with unique customization options.
[h3]February 2024[/h3]
[list][*]New Side Quests 
[*]The Trucker Life Update[/list]February will see us launch our New Side Quests update, where new mission types will be added to the game ensuring that you’ve got more to do, see, and haul. 

We’ll also be adding to the survival experience, with new status effects for your trucker like getting ill, diseases, and much more. Surviving as a trucker will be a more robust experience with deeper systems, coming February 2024.

[h3]Alaskan Road Truckers into the Future[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/cbe1a6f45e1a98705fd80a7bff814346cde5ee29.png[/img]

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers - Final Touches and Steam Reviews
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

We’re fast approaching our PC launch date of October 18 and we’ve been working nonstop to take on board all the feedback we received during our playtests and make sure Alaskan Road Truckers is ready to hit the road.

With a couple of days to go - here’s what’s currently happening with Alaskan Road Truckers!

[h2][b]Community Updates[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/6660053d35707d9f6a214285a50df08b1ed7153b.png[/img]
The feedback, bug reports, and other ideas we’ve received from our community has been amazing. We’ve made tons of updates following our recent playtests, here’s some changes our community has requested that we’ve been able to implement already:

[b]Snow markers in the North of the map[/b] - The real Dalton Highway has snow markers to make sure you’re driving on the road when things get a little cold. We enjoyed not being able to see the road when it’s snowing but we decided, after getting some feedback, that this wasn’t enjoyable for everyone. So snow markers are in - you’ll know exactly where the road is, no matter the weather.

[b]Mouse won’t interrupt steering wheel[/b] - During playtests when you nudged your mouse, it would interrupt inputs from steering wheels. This wasn’t actually a bug, in fact it was a setting that was togglable in the options. However, after reports that this was bothering players, we decided to remove the option and make it so that when you’re using a steering wheel, you won’t find it disconnected by mouse movements anymore.

[b]Camera centering[/b] - Some players didn’t enjoy having the camera center itself automatically when driving. So we’ve made it a button instead! If you want to be looking straight ahead, just hit the assigned key and you’ll be staring straight ahead. If not - there’ll be no interruptions.

[b]Where’s the snow?[/b] - The playtest started players near the beginning of Spring. While we don’t want to throw players in at the deep end, we do know that many of you are anxious to get stuck into the colder parts of the year. As a result of this feedback, players will now start a new game at the beginning of Summer, meaning Winter and all its hazards is that much closer.

[b]Force feedback[/b] - One of the key bits of feedback we received was that force feedback was too strong. We don’t want to shake your desk to pieces, so we’ve made improvements to ensure different types of steering wheels have appropriate levels of force feedback.

In addition to those changes, we’ve made tons of fixes, updates, and tweaks to the game. And more will be coming! Our work on Alaskan Road Truckers isn’t finished at launch, we’re going to add to the game, fix bugs, and be working on it before, during, and after the game comes out. So keep your feedback coming - especially after launch. As Frasier Crane says: we’re listening.

[h2][b]Review us on Steam[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/da4a6138313b37a9cd3e1bab3b0b24e4d87877eb.png[/img]
Speaking of feedback, we have a request to make. After you’ve played the game for at least 2-3 hours please leave a Steam review. Steam reviews are critical to a game’s success; the more reviews we get, the more visibility we get, and the more people will see it. The more people see the game, the better we’ll do, and the better we do, the more we can support and expand our game.

Please note we’re not asking for you to leave a positive review. We want you to voice your honest opinion about the game. If you love it (and we hope you will), we want to hear that. If you don’t - then we want to hear that too. 

So if you can, please leave us a Steam review once the game is out and you’ve played it for a few hours. You can always edit your opinion or expand upon it later, should you so wish.

[list]
[*] Batteries are available at most gas stations and not only in stores
[*] Fixes to invisible bumps on some roads
[*] Fix for the camera prediction resetting itself to "off"
[*] Some traffic fixes (still WIP)

[*] Some landscape fixes
[*] Day-night lighting improvements
[*] Additional traffic improvements

notes.title: Alaskan Road Truckers and Simulation Games - Devlog no. 15
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

There are less than three weeks to go until we launch on Steam. Three weeks! We can barely believe it. We are so excited to be able to release our game into the wild and have you all play it - we hope you’re as excited as we are.

Last week we talked about how Alaskan Road Truckers fits into the field of trucking games, this week we’re going to look at how it compares to simulation games. We’re going to answer the question - is Alaskan Road Truckers a simulation game?

[h2][b]What is a simulation game?[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/6a8a3eddb0f33a6dd7bf9f7ae003f4b46e32c8c6.png[/img]
It’s surprisingly hard to pin down what makes a simulation game a simulation game. It’s an incredibly broad category of gaming, containing games as diverse as Gas Station Simulator, The Sims, and Stardew Valley. Despite allowing players to experience things in a huge variety of ways, there is one thing that unites all simulation games - they simulate an experience.

That experience can be as large as designing, building, and managing your own city or as small as living the moment-to-moment experience of a singular person doing a job. Simulation games are all about putting you into a role and giving you the tools to experience it, most often with a degree of fidelity to real life.

[h2][b]Sims and Alaskan Road Truckers[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/9365093f735880f81c124d82ef3ce7cae7747456.png[/img]
So the question is: where does Alaskan Road Truckers fit into the simulation genre?

Do we simulate an experience? Yes. Alaskan Road Truckers is all about putting you in the shoes (and skin) of an Alaskan trucker. You’ll live, eat, drive, and exist as a trucker, and as a result, many things are simulated. Weather, driving conditions, hunger, energy, health - they’re all in the game, and they make the game step into the simulation space. So on the surface, Alaskan Road Truckers is a simulation game.

That said, we would hesitate to brand Alaskan Road Truckers as pure simulation. We’re focusing more on recreating the feel of being an Alaskan trucker rather than recreating every minute aspect of owning a truck or running a trucking business. We want you to feel like a rugged trucker, working through storms and against the odds to deliver your cargo, we don’t want you to feel like you have a never-ending spreadsheet of tasks to complete before you get to the fun stuff. This is a game inspired by real life, it isn’t a recreation of real life.

We spoke last week about how we’re not aiming to take the crown of trucking sims, and that’s still true. We are an indie team making an indie game and our ambitions are big but still modest. We’re making the best Alaskan trucker experience ever, we aren’t making the most high-fidelity simulation game ever made.

Every aspect of our game has been designed to put you in those trucking boots, and we think you’ll be pleased with the look, sound, feel, and level of simulation we’ve put into the game. 
[h2][b]Playtests? Playtests.[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/12493b6b8a6d6c123a6fed933b37297ab89416b0.png[/img]
We’ve been running limited closed playtests with parts of our community, and we’ve got more planned! If you’d like to take part, the first step is to join our Discord, where you’ll find info on how to sign up:

notes.title: Trucking Sims and Alaskan Road Truckers - Devlog no. 14
notes.notes:
Hello truckers!

We’re warming up our engines ahead of the PC launch of Alaskan Road Truckers - coming [b]October 18, 2023[/b]. We’re excited to let our game out into the wild, and we’re busy working away, making sure our vision of the game is achieved for the launch.

This week we wanted to take a moment to talk about what Alaskan Road Truckers is, where it sits in the field of simulation games, and how it compares to some of the other games out there. We hope this helps everyone understand what Alaskan Road Truckers is meant to be as a game.

[h2][b]Truck Sim or Survival?[/b][/h2]
You might have heard us say (and if you haven’t, where have you been?) that in Alaskan Road Truckers you play as a trucker - not a truck. That isn’t just a snappy marketing slogan, it’s core to the identity of our game and how we differentiate ourselves from other trucking games out there right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/d66bbcf1e89ecc86ecde5da9dbaf9822db34c810.png[/img]
In other trucking simulation games, what’s simulated is the truck. Not only driving the truck, but maintenance, upkeep, refueling, and loads of other aspects of running a truck - and often running a trucking business too.

When we decided to make Alaskan Road Truckers, we decided to take it one step further. Instead of simulating only your truck, what about the person driving it? Setting the game in Alaska, one of the most varied and rugged environments on the planet, helped us in deciding to focus the game all around living as a trucker, not simply driving a truck.

From there, the gameplay concepts flow naturally. You’re a human in Alaskan Road Truckers, so you need to eat, sleep, and stay healthy. Then things like temperature begin to play a part too, you have to stay warm in the harsh winters of the frozen North. These all helped us to flesh out what Alaskan Road Truckers is - it’s not just a trucking simulation game, it’s a survival game too where you take your life in your hands every time you climb out of your cab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/bd717d42df8dc8005dac8cdf99b5095b147e628f.png[/img]
It didn’t just stop there - these ideas around survival also helped us provide a deeper trucking experience. The weather will also affect your truck - too cold and it won’t start. We added hazards to the roads so you’ll either have to clear them (if you can) or take detours, which can affect not only your ability to complete your current job but also if you’re unprepared for a lengthy trip, you might run out of fuel, your truck might break down, and you might end up cold and hungry in the wilderness.

From a simple start - what about playing as a trucker, not a truck - we’ve expanded our ideas to incorporate a ton of gameplay systems that add up to what we believe is a compelling simulation of trucking life. So when you look at Alaskan Road Truckers and other games and wonder why you should check us out, remember that we’re offering something fundamentally different.

[h2][b]How Alaskan Road Truckers Compares[/b][/h2]
There are more trucking simulators released every year and a couple of big names that currently hold the trucking crown. It’s important to remember that we’re not aiming to take their crowns - we’re not looking to be the best trucking simulation game ever made. We’re looking to be the best truck[b]er[/b] simulation game ever made.

Let’s look at American Truck Simulator for an example. The team at SCS created vast swathes of the USA (with more to come) and have the pre-eminent American trucking game out there. We’re offering something fundamentally different to ATS. We’ve built a smaller experience, focusing on nailing the every day feeling of being a trucker living in Alaska. As we mentioned in last week’s devlog, we’re a small team, so we’ve made our game deeper - not broader.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/4f3408b0e87a95c8fc833c1c24bdd50e497f9390.png[/img]
That’s not to say that it’s not important that we have a varied map and a satisfying driving experience - we do, and we’ve made sure that there’s plenty to see and many realistic roads to rumble over in your truck. We’ve ensured that driving your truck in-game feels like driving a truck, you’ll be spending many hours behind the wheel, so we needed to make sure that this is up to scratch. As we continue to support the game after launch we’ll also be adding more to the map and the experience, stay tuned for our post-release roadmap -  coming soon!

We’ve also decided to launch on consoles, bringing our trucker experience to a wider audience who desperately need a solid trucking game on console. The biggest trucking games are still currently PC only, and we felt that console players deserve to get the same chance to live as a trucker as those on PC. We haven’t announced our console launch date just yet - but it is coming. We can’t wait to get the game in front of PS5 and Xbox Series X/S players - and we hope you’ll love what we’ve got in store for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33660248/9608c580d99e9709f66cbeb59c84bd9e6dfd3010.png[/img]
[h2][b]More Beta Previews[/b][/h2]
Over the last week, we’d seen more people play our beta build and share their experiences on Twitch and YouTube. Here are a few of the wonderful previews that have come in over the last seven days:

We’re currently running some limited invitation playtests of our beta build of the game. To make sure you’re in with a chance to be selected, join our Discord and join in the conversation. Come hang out with us and talk about trucks!

[h2][b]Stay in Touch[/b][/h2]
Now you’ve read all about how Alaskan Road Truckers fits into the field of trucking sims it’s time to head over to our store page and smash that wishlist button. We’re launching on the 18th of October, so make sure you're ready to hit the road with us!
